name: Yunohana SpRING!
source:
The protagonist, Yunoha, is the only-child of the owner of the Fukujurou bath house in Ayagawakai Onsen. She longs for the big city life, so one day she decided to ignore her parents' disprovals and leave the countryside.

However, once Yunoha heard news that her mother had fallen, she returned to her home. Once she arrived, she learned that her family's bath house business was supposed to be thriving, but it was barren of customers! It appeared that the new resorts built around the area were overshadowing the traditional, small businesses.

"But our business has it's quirks, you know!"

And thus she became the temporary landlady of the bath house with solid determination.

With unique employees,
and customers with their own reasons for staying,
her days are becoming busy as she tries to earn profit for her family while dealing with love.
It's all confusing, but at the same time, it's full of heart-pounding moments!?
What will become of her future?

[Translation from the [url=http://www.otomate.jp/yunohana_spring]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公柚乃叶是绫川海温泉福寿楼浴场老板的独生女。她向往大城市的生活，于是某天不顾父母反对，决定离开乡下。

然而，听到母亲病倒的消息后，柚乃叶回到了家乡。抵达后她才得知，家里的浴场生意本应蒸蒸日上，却门可罗雀！原来，周边新建的度假村抢走了传统小店的客源。

“但我们也有自己的特色嘛！”

就这样，她怀着坚定的决心，暂时成为浴场老板娘。

面对各具特色的员工，以及出于各自理由前来住宿的客人，她一边为家族赚钱，一边应付恋爱，日子变得忙碌起来。
一切都让人困惑，却又充满令人心跳加速的时刻！？
她的未来会变成什么样？

[译自[url=http://www.otomate.jp/yunohana_spring]官方网站[/url]]
